findings.evidence: The prose after “No infinite value is permitted;” is malformed, including “Which metric axiom list … records why …” and “as … proves.” The metric axioms are explicit and nonnegativity is separately supplied by a lemma; the explanatory prose needs an editorial repair.

The sentence “The inner integral is a measurable function of x, by A randomized procedure has a measurable action law, so …” is malformed. The risk formula and measurability supplier are explicit, but the explanatory sentence needs its grammatical connection restored.
